title: Should I add people to the game?
author: Gloomy_Option205
selftext:
New update on my demolition game   
  
Been busy improving things: added more buildings to smash and polished the physics so the destruction feels way more satisfying

Built on Rezona Lab, and this time I used Fable 5 to tweak the gameplay and collapse mechanism.

Let me know if you wanna try the game

comments.author: bball-biopic
comments.body: Maybe you could add a truck to clean up the rubble or something or upgrades to make your bulldozer better

replies.author: Gloomy_Option205
replies.body: sounds great, I will think about it

comments.author: ThisIsDurian
comments.body: If you want to make a kids friendly game, let humans walk around with safety hats.

replies.author: Gloomy_Option205
replies.body: thank you, its a good idea

comments.author: x10der_by
comments.body: You can add airplanes in your game

comments.author: morbidflood
comments.body: Do you die if the building collapses on you?

comments.author: Dazzling_Equipment_9
comments.body: This game makes me feel uncomfortable.
